name: io.github.tunguyen1993/antigravity-x402-mcp-gateway
title: Antigravity x402 & MCP Gateway
description: Deterministic security, compliance, finance, and regulatory APIs via Streamable-HTTP MCP and x402.

tools.name: list_x402_pricing_and_wallets
tools.description: Free discovery tool returning all paid x402 endpoints, USDC prices, supported chains (Base eip155:8453 & Polygon eip155:137), and sample payloads.

tools.name: scan_agent_payload_security
tools.description: [0.003000 USDC via x402] Scans untrusted agent tool outputs, prompts, or code patches for prompt-injection overrides, Unicode bidi trojans (CVE-2021-42574), leaked private keys, unsafe deserialization, shell injection, and exfiltration sinks in under 20 ms.

content.description: Code snippet, git diff, or untrusted agent tool output text to scan (up to 120,000 chars).

tools.name: audit_domain_security_posture
tools.description: [0.005000 USDC via x402] Performs a 100% passive, non-intrusive security posture audit of any public domain across TLS 1.2/1.3 & X.509 hygiene (25 pts), OWASP HTTP headers (40 pts), DoH SPF/DMARC/CAA (30 pts), and RFC 9116 /.well-known/security.txt (5 pts), returning a 0-100 score, A+..F grade, and fixes.

domain.description: Public domain or hostname to audit passively (e.g., 'cloudflare.com').

tools.name: compute_wind_lcoe_and_eya
tools.description: [0.005000 USDC via x402] Computes IEC-grounded Weibull P50/P75/P90 net annual energy production (MWh) with RSS uncertainty and exact Decimal project finance metrics (Total CAPEX, LCOE $/MWh, NPV, Project IRR %, Min P90 DSCR).

capacity_mw.description: Installed wind farm nameplate capacity in MW (0.5 to 5000).

mean_wind_speed_ms.description: Hub-height annual mean wind speed in m/s (default '7.8').

weibull_k.description: Weibull shape parameter k between 1.2 and 4.0 (default '2.1').

capex_usd_per_kw.description: Total installed CAPEX in USD per kW (default '1350').

opex_usd_per_kw_yr.description: Annual O&M OPEX in USD per kW-year (default '36').

ppa_price_usd_per_mwh.description: Power Purchase Agreement tariff in USD per MWh (default '78.0').

wake_loss_pct.description: Array wake loss percentage between 0 and 30 (default '7.5').

project_years.description: Operating project lifetime in years between 5 and 35 (default 20).

tools.name: fetch_sec_form_d_startup_leads
tools.description: [0.010000 USDC via x402] Queries official SEC EDGAR EFTS Form D filings from the past 120 days and parses XML primary documents to return exact Decimal USD offering amounts, amounts sold, states, and executive rosters.

query.description: Keyword or company query for SEC EDGAR Form D search (default 'AI', e.g., 'robotics', 'biotech').

limit.description: Maximum number of parsed Form D filings to return (1 to 5, default 3).

tools.name: analyze_substack_newsletter
tools.description: [0.005000 USDC via x402] Analyzes any public Substack newsletter or custom-domain Substack publication to extract recent posts, publishing cadence (posts/week), average likes/comments/restacks, outbound links, and probable sponsor/advertiser domains.

publication.description: Substack subdomain, handle, or custom domain URL (e.g., 'importai.substack.com').

max_posts.description: Maximum number of recent archive posts to analyze (1 to 12, default 5).

tools.name: fetch_fdic_bank_health
tools.description: [0.005000 USDC via x402] Queries official FDIC BankFind Suite institutions data to return active US bank total assets, total deposits, equity capital, exact Decimal equity-to-assets ratio, ROA %, ROE %, and CERT ID.

limit.description: Maximum number of matching FDIC institutions to return (1 to 10, default 3).

tools.name: fetch_openfda_recalls
tools.description: [0.005000 USDC via x402] Queries official US FDA openFDA enforcement feeds across food, drug, or medical device recalls, returning recall numbers, Class I/II/III severity, recalling firms, product descriptions, and reasons.

query.description: Optional keyword filter across recall reason and product description (e.g., 'allergen', 'listeria').

limit.description: Maximum number of recall records to return (1 to 10, default 5).

tools.name: check_cisa_kev_exploits
tools.description: [0.004000 USDC via x402] Checks any CVE identifier or vendor/product keyword against the live CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) catalog, returning active exploitation status, ransomware usage, due dates, and CWEs.

query.description: Exact CVE ID (e.g., 'CVE-2024-21762') or vendor/product keyword (e.g., 'Fortinet', 'Ivanti').

limit.description: Maximum matching KEV entries to return (1 to 15, default 5).

tools.name: recon_rdap_domain
tools.description: [0.004000 USDC via x402] Queries authoritative IANA RDAP registries for any public domain to extract registrar identity, registration and expiration timestamps, EPP status flags, DNSSEC delegation status, and nameservers.

domain.description: Public domain name to query via IANA RDAP (e.g., 'cloudflare.com').

tools.name: assess_live_wind_eya
tools.description: [0.008000 USDC via x402] Fetches live hourly 100m wind speed, temperature, and pressure for any global (latitude, longitude), applies IEC 61400-12 shear & air-density scaling to hub height, fits Weibull k, and computes P50/P90 AEP & LCOE.

hub_height_m.description: Turbine hub height in meters between 40 and 220 (default 120).

capacity_mw.description: Planned wind farm nameplate capacity in MW (default '50').

ppa_price_usd_per_mwh.description: Power Purchase Agreement tariff in USD per MWh (default '78.0').

tools.name: screen_ofac_sanctions
tools.description: [0.006000 USDC via x402] Screens any individual, company, vessel, or Base/Ethereum/Bitcoin/Solana/Tron/Monero cryptocurrency wallet address against the live US Treasury OFAC Specially Designated Nationals (SDN) list, AKAs, and overflow digital currency remarks in under 15 ms.

query.description: Person, company, organization, vessel name, or cryptocurrency wallet address to screen against OFAC SDN.

wallet_address.description: Optional explicit EVM (0x...), Bitcoin/Bech32, Solana, Tron, or Monero address for exact OFAC Digital Currency Address matching.

min_score.description: IDF-weighted match score threshold between 0.50 and 1.00 (default 0.75).

tools.name: evaluate_token_risk_verdict
tools.description: [0.008000 USDC via x402] Combines GoPlus contract & Solana Token-2022 security telemetry (honeypot, mintable, freeze/permanent-delegate authority, transfer hooks/fees, proxy, unlocked EOA whale concentration) with live DexScreener chain-scoped USD liquidity, 24h volume, and FDV into a 0-100 safety verdict.

token_address.description: 0x EVM token contract address or case-sensitive Solana Base58 mint address.

tools.name: fetch_crypto_derivatives_pulse
tools.description: [0.005000 USDC via x402] Returns real-time Hyperliquid L1 perpetual mark/oracle basis (bps), hourly funding rate, simple annualized funding carry APR % (annualized_funding_carry_pct), hourly-compounded APY % (annualized_compounded_apy_pct), USD open interest, 24h volume, and Deribit 30-day BTC/ETH options implied volatility index (DVOL).

symbols.description: List of non-empty perpetual ticker strings to query (up to 12, default ['BTC','ETH','SOL','XRP','HYPE']).

tools.name: audit_uk_property_postcode
tools.description: [0.006000 USDC via x402] Audits any geographic UK postcode across ONS/Postcodes.io administrative boundaries, Environment Agency nearby 3km river/coastal flood zones (England), and UK Home Office Police street-level crime incidents (England, Wales & Northern Ireland) with explicit devolved-jurisdiction coverage notes.

tools.name: verify_gleif_lei_entity
tools.description: [0.005000 USDC via x402] Verifies corporate counterparties via the official GLEIF Global LEI Index by legal entity name or strict ISO 17442 20-char LEI code, ranking active issued parent corporations first with BIC mappings.

query.description: Company legal name (e.g., 'Apple Inc.', 'Microsoft', 'BlackRock') or ISO 17442 20-character LEI code.

limit.description: Maximum matching LEI entity records to return (1 to 10, default 3).

tools.name: scan_prediction_market_arb
tools.description: [0.008000 USDC via x402] Scans active high-volume Polymarket Gamma CLOB and CFTC-regulated Kalshi v2 binary Yes/No contracts in real time, computing exact Decimal implied probabilities, executable orderbook asks, market-maker vig %, and strict invariant-verified cross-venue pairs with two-leg gross arbitrage edge %.

query.description: Optional case-insensitive topic filter (e.g., 'Fed', 'BTC', 'Bitcoin', 'Trump', 'GDP', 'inflation', 'NATO', or '' for top volume).

limit.description: Maximum contracts per venue and cross-venue arbitrage pairs to return (1 to 25, default 8).

tools.name: compute_portfolio_tail_risk
tools.description: [0.010000 USDC via x402] Computes coherent empirical daily 95% and 99% Value at Risk (VaR), 95% Expected Shortfall (CVaR), simple and log daily returns, annualized volatility, max drawdown, Sharpe, Sortino, Probabilistic Sharpe confidence, and minimum-variance BTC short hedge USD notional from UTC-midnight-aligned DefiLlama daily price history.

assets.description: Portfolio weights (shorthand tickers BTC/ETH/SOL/LINK/UNI/AAVE/ARB/OP or 'coingecko:...' IDs).

portfolio_value_usd.description: Total portfolio notional in USD for dollar VaR/CVaR and hedge sizing (default '100000').

lookback_days.description: Historical daily lookback window in UTC days between 14 and 90 (default 60).

tools.name: fetch_sec_insider_and_8k
tools.description: [0.010000 USDC via x402] Resolves any US public equity ticker (including class shares like BRK.B / BRK/B), 10-digit CIK, company name, or multi-issuer theme against SEC EDGAR submissions and 90-day EFTS full-text index to extract deduplicated Form 4 insider filings, decoded Form 8-K item catalysts, and activity band.

query.description: Stock ticker (e.g., 'NVDA', 'AAPL', 'BRK/B', 'COIN'), 10-digit CIK, company name, or multi-issuer theme ('Crypto', 'Quantum', 'AI chip').

limit.description: Maximum recent Form 4 and Form 8-K filings to return (1 to 25, default 8).

tools.name: verify_b2b_email_deliverability
tools.description: [0.004000 USDC via x402] Verifies a single email or batch of up to 20 emails via RFC 5322 + IDNA lowercase normalization, role-inbox and 90+ disposable burner domain rejection, primary-first RFC 8427 DNS-over-HTTPS MX provider classification (Google Workspace, Gmail Consumer, Microsoft 365, Apple iCloud / Corporate, Proofpoint, Mimecast, Cisco Secure Email, Broadcom Symantec, Barracuda, AWS SES, Cloudflare Email Routing, Proton Mail, Zoho Mail, Fastmail, Custom), RFC 7489 organizational-apex DMARC fallback, and IANA-bootstrapped RDAP apex domain age (< 30 days fraud flag).

email.description: Single email address to verify (e.g., 'tim@apple.com'). Provide either 'email' or 'emails'.

emails.description: Batch of 1 to 20 email addresses to verify in a single request.

tools.name: audit_package_supply_chain
tools.description: [0.005000 USDC via x402] Audits 1 to 50 open-source dependencies across npm, PyPI, Crates.io, Go, Maven, NuGet, RubyGems, and Packagist against Google OSV.dev querybatch with round-robin advisory enrichment, deduplicates aliased CVEs across GHSA/PYSEC, enriches CVEs with live FIRST.org EPSS 30-day exploitation probabilities and CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) status, and computes PEP-440/SemVer pre-release-aware fixed versions plus a deterministic CI/CD release gate.

packages.description: List of 1 to 50 package objects ({ecosystem, name, version}) to audit.

name.description: Exact package name in the target ecosystem.

version.description: Installed or pinned package version string.

tools.name: fetch_biotech_and_gov_contracts
tools.description: [0.008000 USDC via x402] Queries NIH ClinicalTrials.gov API v2 (sponsor-first with keyword backfill, deduplicated by NCT ID) for phase, status, sponsor, conditions, and primary completion dates alongside USAspending.gov API v2 prime federal contract awards sorted by exact Decimal USD obligation amount.

query.description: Company, drug/therapy, pathogen, or technology keyword (e.g., 'Pfizer', 'Moderna', 'SpaceX').

limit.description: Maximum records per source to return (1 to 10, default 5).
